title: European leader confides about UFOs on a park walk

tellings.quote: walked in the park for a while and he was telling me something very interesting about these things.

plain: Sometime in the late 1990s an unnamed European leader went for a walk in a park with Kiran Ilum Xenov, a former president of a republic within Russia, and told him something very interesting about UFOs. Ilum Xenov tells it himself but does not say who the leader was or what he said. It matters because it would mean heads of state talk privately about these things.
